description.narrative: Human Rights Association in Istanbul (HRA from now on) continues to monitor human rights violations. They followed up 491 violations, had 20 internal trainings, 12 public panels and 209 press conferences.Despite threats and attacks, (HRA from now on) continued their activities. During 2023, trainings, documentation, reporting, information, and awareness-raising activities were carried out. During special days, as Pride Week, 8 March Womens Day, Workers Day and so on, HRA reached over 1 million people through social media and direct contact with about 15000 people.The earthquake had of course effect on HRA as well as the threats that has continued and has been a stress situation for the staff and activists. HRA continues to request meetings with governorship and different ministries and there has been some result regarding some decisions that were partially lifted.The solidarity between institutions have increased, but this is not something that goes out publicly due to prevent negative reactions. The political and economic atmosphere in Trkiye is still difficult and HRA feels the anxiety among the rights holders, they have tried to reduce this anxiety by continuing the activities.
